reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses laser cladding of HEAs and AlNbTiZr MEA coatings on Zr alloys, but neither provides any data on Si-doped Cr coatings, Cr-silicide interlayer formation, or its diffusion barrier effect. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Si addition to Cr coating forms a continuous Cr-silicide interlayer at the Cr/Zr interface
This interlayer acts as a diffusion barrier limiting Cr–Zr interdiffusion at high temperature
Si addition maintains protective Cr2O3 scale formation under normal subcritical water conditions
Optimal Si doping is around 3 at%, with excessive Si (>5 at%) causing embrittlement
